chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Bint Ilyas, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When you stand [for prayer] and the dawn has risen, begin with the Witr, then pray the two rak'ahs, then pray the remaining rak'ahs when morning comes.'

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: The two rak'ahs (specific units of prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order of prayers when waking up after dawn has risen?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Sunnah of performing Witr before the Fajr prayer, a practice emphasized in Shia jurisprudence to ensure the night prayer is not missed if one sleeps. The sequence underscores the spiritual priority of concluding the night with voluntary acts before engaging in the obligatory dawn prayer, reflecting the holistic nature of daily worship in Shia tradition.
